$comment: Which Terraform root under infra/terraform/environments/ is CURRENTLY the declared-authoritative one for each environment's API/gateway. infra/terraform/scripts/test_region_colocation.py reads this file (no AWS credentials) to know which roots to check for aws_region == database_region.
